programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, host Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart and soul of Budapest, Hungary’s enchanting capital. From panoramic views at Fisherman’s Bastion to the colorful stalls of Central Market Hall, she explores the city’s rich blend of history, food, and culture. Sandra soaks in centuries of tradition at the famous Gellért Thermal Baths, where locals come daily to relax in mineral-rich waters. She then dines at the legendary Gundel Restaurant, where Hungarian staples like goulash and Gundel pancakes are served with royal flair and historical significance. Between bites and baths, Sandra shares practical travel tips—how to ride the tram, when to cross the Danube for the best sunset views, and why you should book Parliament tickets in advance. Whether you're drawn to architecture, cuisine, or unforgettable experiences, this episode proves that Budapest is a city worth savoring—one authentic moment at a time.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore takes families on a journey where history and adventure come together in unforgettable ways. From navigating the hedge maze at Vienna’s Schönbrunn Palace—once a playground for royalty—to wandering the lavish halls of Cairo’s Abdeen Palace, this trip is anything but ordinary. In Aswan, families pause for an elegant high tea at the Old Cataract Hotel, the very place where Agatha Christie wrote Death on the Nile. It’s a moment of calm and connection, with sweeping Nile views and Egyptian charm. The journey wraps in Prague, where a vintage Alfa Romeo transforms a sightseeing tour into a glamorous ride through history. More than just sightseeing, Family Travel celebrates curiosity, culture, and time spent together. Whether you're sipping tea or solving a maze, these experiences spark conversations—and memories—that last long after the trip is over.

programme.title: Edible Nutmeg: On the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Plum and the team are joined by Chef Adam Bedini as they head out to the countryside to visit Peter Fay and Mohawk Bison in Goshen, CT. Tour the farm with Plum and try out a unique summer grilling recipe! and Chef Plum takes Edible Nutmeg on the road to Oxford, CT to speak with the guys who make Black Hog Brewery's exceptional beer and learn a unique recipe for garlicky, gingery, beer-infused clams!

programme.title: Adventure All Stars
programme.desc: The Sapphire Coast is located approximately halfway between Melbourne and Sydney and just three hours from Canberra, located on the far south coast of New South Wales. The roll call of magnificence is almost endless in this gem-like stretch of coast, the most southerly in the state. Discover some of the world’s best whale watching, oysters plucked straight from pristine waters, beaches where yours will be the only footprints, immense tracts of national parks and serene ocean pools. Has a coastline ever been better named?

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.
